scope: Full-resolution visual review of every sample in the four predeclared original texture controls; no model processing

frames.observation: Asymmetric red/green/blue/yellow pattern and white bars are visible on the neutral back wall, floor and plinth. Red/blue side walls, three spheres, box and three dark posts remain visible. Back-wall quadrant appearance follows the original UV chart axes, not an assumed image-axis layout. Other materials retain Color constants and default maps.

All room fixtures remain visible. The center sphere has a bright highlight and a sharp, visibly coarse reflection containing exterior trees/terrain and foreground posts. The right sphere and box are tan/brown, left sphere white, walls red/blue. Environment reflection differs from the isolated Cycles reference and remains a calibration concern.

The center sphere has broad smooth shading without the sharp scenery reflection of the packed control. Other fixtures remain in the same visible arrangement. This is a roughness-channel response under outdoor light, not a measured physical roughness match.

The center sphere appears white and nonmetallic with a small highlight; the sharp scenery reflection is absent. Fine mottling remains along its lower edge, also visible on the left sphere. All fixtures remain visible. This does not establish fidelity to a reference BRDF or motion stability.
